title: ZYNKEEL THE GAMELAN (Gqom × Gamelan × Bass Music) [128]
style: South African gqom meets Indonesian gamelan and bass music, 128 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Zulu + Indonesian + te reo Maori, broken gqom kick and tom pattern, bronze gamelan gong and metallophone melodies, distorted deep sub bass, ritual log drums, sparse claps, hypnotic call-and-response chops, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, ceremonial-warehouse-trance mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, club world-fusion 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(bronze gamelan gong, soft pad, distant tom)
(ZYN... KEEL... ga... me... lan...)
(sa... ni... bo... na... sa... ni...)
(se... la... mat... se... la... mat...)

[Build]
(gqom kick-tom pattern locks in, sub slides up)
ZYN — KEEL! GA — ME — LAN!
SA — NI — BO — NA!
SE — LA — MAT!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(metallophone climb, log drum roll)

[Drop 1]
(broken gqom groove, gamelan stabs, distorted sub)
ZYN — KEEL!
HOME — RING!
WAKE — ROOM!
BRONZE — SOUND!
(chop stack +7) yebo-yebo-ya-ya / āe-āe-yebo-yebo
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(metallophone solo phrase, ritual claps, chops trade)
(uphi?) (di mana?) (kei hea?)
(la-pha!) (di sini!) (konei!)
(woza!) (mari!) (haere mai!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE GONG —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to gamelan + soft drone, no kick)
(whispered) zynkeel... gamelan...
(soft) sanibona... sanibona...
(soft) selamat... selamat...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(log drum roll builds, gqom returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time gqom, full gamelan stack peak, distorted sub)
ZYN — KEEL — GA — ME — LAN! (yebo yebo yebo!)
HOME — RING! (woza! mari! haere mai!)
BRONZE — SOUND! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(kick fades, gamelan resolves, gong holds)
(zynkeel... gamelan...)
(sanibona... selamat...)
(haere... mai...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(bronze gong holds long, fade to silence)
